primary_source_policy: Answer-bearing Gospel claims are source-bounded to cited canonical passages. WEBU/eBible is the named developer audit text basis. No external historical claim is graded in this lane.

repair_metadata.note: Only duplicate-book surface artifacts, if any, were normalized.

sources.source_name: SBL Greek New Testament (SBLGNT), Mark 16 apparatus / reverse-interlinear note
sources.audit_use: Confirms the major longer-ending transmission boundary; some manuscript streams end at Mark 16:8 while the traditional longer ending contains 16:9–20.
sources.grading_boundary: Any node using Mark 16:9–20 carries TX1 and accepts responsible translations/editions that bracket, footnote, or omit the longer ending.

sources.source_name: SBL Greek New Testament (SBLGNT), Luke 23:34a apparatus / reverse-interlinear note
sources.audit_use: Records that important manuscripts omit the first crucifixion saying in Luke 23:34a.
sources.grading_boundary: The project never penalizes a responsible edition for including, bracketing, footnoting, or omitting Luke 23:34a.

sources.source_name: SBLGNT / modern critical-edition note for John 1:34 title variation
sources.audit_use: Title variation after the Baptist's testimony is material if exact title wording is graded.
sources.grading_boundary: GW-01 grades only that the Baptist saw/testified, not the variant title, so no title-form is required.
